# Test fixtures

- `deck.pptx`, `deck.ppt`: four-slide decks (slide 3 hidden; notes on slides 1, 3 and 4) made for the import tests.
- `presenter.jpg`: portrait of astronaut Eileen Collins (NASA, public domain), as shipped in
  scikit-image's sample data (`skimage.data.astronaut`), scaled to 480×480. Used to check that
  the presenter is found and cut out of a real photo.
